stem:
Myra's PE teacher asks the class to mark equal intervals of time for a shuttle-run drill, but nobody has a watch.

Which process can be used to measure time?

options.text: A simple pendulum that swings back and forth with a steady period.
Irregular handclaps that come at different gaps each time.
An old mechanical clock that looks worn cannot measure time at all.
A regularly swinging pendulum without a numbered face cannot measure time.

teacher.key_rationale: A process that repeats after definite intervals can mark equal times; irregular claps cannot, and a face is not required.
